Hi team,

Local English-speaking guide rates for Hanoi city tours, valid 01/01/2026 - 31/12/2026:

Full day (up to 15 pax, 1 group): VND 900.000/day
Half day (up to 15 pax, 1 group): VND 550.000/day

Guide meal allowance: VND 150.000/day
Guide accommodation (when overnight required): actual cost + VND 100.000 service fee

Regards,
Hanoi Local Guides Association
